**Page**  
Title: *The Use of Match Statistics that Discriminate Between Successful and Unsuccessful Soccer Teams*  
URL: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3588662/  

**Evidence**  

- “The analysis was based on 177 matches played during the three most recent World Cup tournaments: Korea/Japan 2002 (59), Germany 2006 (59) and South Africa 2010 (59).”  
- “The data was obtained from the FIFA website… The final sample therefore comprised 59 matches from each of the three World Cups (equivalent to 92.2 % of all matches played).”  
- “The following match statistics were gathered: goals scored, total shots, shots on target, shots off target, ball possession, off‑sides, fouls, corners, yellow cards and red cards (both committed and received for the two teams).”  
- “Table 2 shows the descriptive results derived from the match statistics for winning, drawing and losing teams …”  
- “Table 3 shows the descriptive results derived from the match statistics for winning, drawing and losing teams in each of the three World Cups studied.”  
- “Table 4 presents the results of the discriminant analysis for all three World Cups.”  
- “Table 5 shows the structural coefficients (SC) derived from the discriminant analysis of each World Cup separately.”  
- “The analysis was based on 177 matches … (59 matches from each of the three World Cups).”  
- “50 matches were excluded due to extra time; the final sample comprised 59 matches from each of the three World Cups.”  
- “The goal‑related variables were: goals scored, total shots, shots on target, shots off target…”  

**Coverage**  
- **Entities**: National teams that competed in the 2002, 2006, and 2010 FIFA World Cups; aggregate of all 177 matches across the three tournaments.  
- **Years**: 2002 (Korea/Japan), 2006 (Germany), 2010 (South Africa).  
- **Conditions**: Match statistics such as goals scored, total shots, shots on target, shots off target, ball possession, off‑sides, fouls, corners, yellow cards, and red cards for both teams.  
- **Scope**: General descriptive statistics and discriminant analysis for entire tournaments; no individual match details such as attendance, injuries, or specific player performances.  

**Missing**  
- Specific match attendance figures (e.g., “over 40,000 people attended”).  
- Individual match result (winning margin, scoreline).  
- Injury status of particular squads or players.  
- Player‑level data (e.g., defender with >25 league appearances, substitute scorer with <10 loan goals).  
- Yellow card count for the match.  

**Next links**  
- PDF download: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3588662/pdf/jhk-31-137.pdf – contains full tables and possibly more detailed numerical data not visible in the HTML view.  
- Publisher view: https://doi.org/10.2478/v10078-012-0015-7 – provides the full article text with tables.  

**Status**: partial (the page provides only generic tournament‑level match statistics; it does not contain the specific match details required to answer the original question).
